question: Anda menemukan akun media sosial palsu yang menyerang instansi Anda menggunakan foto palsu. Tindakan pertama yang tepat adalah...

options.B: Dokumentasikan dan laporkan ke humas/divisi TIK

explanation: A (1 poin): Cyberwar. B (5 poin): Prosedur tepat, dokumentasi, eskalasi ke unit berwenang. C (2 poin): Abaikan hoax berbahaya. D (1 poin): Amplifikasi. E (1 poin): Retreat.

question: Password Anda bocor dan akun email kantor disalahgunakan. Tindakan Anda adalah...

options.A: Diam dan buat akun baru sendiri
options.B: Lapor IT security dan ganti password segera

explanation: A (2 poin): Hidden breach. B (5 poin): Security awareness, containment, recovery. C (1 poin): Ignore threat. D (2 poin): Blame. E (1 poin): Compromise more.

question: Anda menerima email phishing yang mengatasnamakan bank mitra. Tindakan Anda adalah...

options.B: Hapus dan laporkan ke IT security
options.C: Balas email dengan data yang diminta
options.E: Hubungi bank melalui nomor di email

explanation: A (1 poin): Fall victim. B (5 poin): Security best practice, report phishing. C (1 poin): Data breach. D (4 poin): Awareness tapi risiko spread. E (1 poin): Contact attacker.

question: Rekan meminta password WiFi kantor untuk tamunya. Sikap Anda adalah...

options.B: Tolak dan arahkan ke prosedur guest access

explanation: A (2 poin): Security risk. B (5 poin): Policy compliance, proper channel. C (2 poin): Policy violation. D (2 poin): Unhelpful. E (1 poin): Critical breach.

question: Anda menemukan data pribadi klien tersimpan tidak terenkripsi di laptop lama. Tindakan Anda adalah...

options.B: Lapor keamanan dan hapus dengan prosedur aman

explanation: A (1 poin): Data exposure risk. B (5 poin): Data protection, proper disposal. C (3 poin): Action tapi no audit trail. D (1 poin): Copy violation. E (1 poin): Data breach.

question: Aplikasi kerja Anda memerlukan update security patch. Anda sedang sibuk deadline. Tindakan Anda adalah...

options.D: Mint IT disable update untuk Anda

explanation: A (2 poin): Vulnerability window. B (5 poin): Security first, patch management. C (1 poin): Disable protection. D (2 poin): Exception policy. E (1 poin): Unpatched vulnerability.
